    logic = f"依據 {obs_id} 數據，{name}({code}) 最新收盤價為 {raw_obs[code][2]} 元。基本面方面，最新營收月增率為 {raw_obs[code][11]}%、年增率為 {raw_obs[code][12]}%，ROE 為 {raw_obs[code][13]}%。技術與動能面，近 20 日報酬率為 {raw_obs[code][3]}%，近 20 日超額報酬達 {raw_obs[code][5]}%，價格距 20 日均線乖離率為 {raw_obs[code][6]}%，近 5 日 20 日均線變化率為 {raw_obs[code][7]}%，14 日 RSI 為 {raw_obs[code][8]}。籌碼面，外資近 5 日買超強度為 {raw_obs[code][15]}% (單日外資買賣超 {raw_obs[code][14]:,.0f} 股)，投信近 5 日買超強度為 {raw_obs[code][17]}% (單日投信買賣超 {raw_obs[code][16]:,.0f} 股)。綜合評估，{item['opp']}，雖然面臨 {item['risk']}，但在大盤 risk_off 與基金 hold 防守姿態下，定位為「{item['role']}」，維持既有配置續抱，建議目標權重為 {item['target_w']*100:.1f}%。"
    
    conclusion = f"維持持有 {name}({code})，定位為{item['role']}，建議目標權重約 {item['target_w']*100:.1f}%。"
    counter_evidence = item["risk"]
    confidence = item["conf"]
    
    inf_obj = {
        "inf_id": inf_id,
        "premise_refs": premise_refs,
        "logic": logic,
        "conclusion": conclusion,
        "counter_evidence": counter_evidence,
        "confidence": confidence
    }
    inferences.append(inf_obj)

print("Generated inferences count:", len(inferences))
# Check lengths
for inf in inferences:
    assert 20 <= len(inf["logic"]) <= 1000, f"Logic length error: {len(inf['logic'])}"
    assert len(inf["conclusion"]) <= 300, f"Conclusion length error: {len(inf['conclusion'])}"
    if inf["counter_evidence"]:
        assert len(inf["counter_evidence"]) <= 500, f"Counter evidence length error: {len(inf['counter_evidence'])}"
    assert 0.0 <= inf["confidence"] <= 1.0
    for p in inf["premise_refs"]:
        assert p in obs_map.values()
print("All validations passed!")

output_obj = {"inferences": inferences}
json_str = json.dumps(output_obj, ensure_ascii=False)
print("Length of json_str:", len(json_str))
# Test reload
loaded = json.loads(json_str)
print("Keys:", list(loaded.keys()))
print("Number of inferences:", len(loaded["inferences"]))
